# Briefing: Fewer FOS complaints begins with better claims decisions [...] The introduction of the Insurance Act 2015 sought to improve fairness and transparency in the relationship between insurer and policyholder. Alongside developments in complaint handling, the industry’s broader focus has increasingly been on ensuring that customers are treated fairly and understand the decisions that affect them.

Ultimately, the FOS exists to provide consumers with access to an impartial decision when agreement cannot be reached.
